entities.summary: Werner Heuser was a German painter, engraver, drafter, and professor. He had been a professor of art at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf from 1926 until 1937, and he was removed from his position by the National Socialists for being a "degenerate artist". After World War II, he rebuilt the academy, serving as the Director between 1946 until 1949.
